title: Raw header names
lead: Fields report `name` and `nameParts` after squalify trims them and applies the header grammar, so `Val(V)` and `Val(V) ` are one name and `RowID( id )` has the unit `id`. Add each field's raw header text exactly as it appears in the file. **Not in this slice:** changing the header grammar (sq-21).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A library consumer matches columns by their exact header text and treats `Val(V)` and `Val(V) ` as two columns. It now re-reads the header line itself and splits it with its own parser, and checks only that the column counts agree.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `HeaderDetector`, the field profile, the descriptor and descriptor.md, README

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A header with leading and trailing spaces, a quoted name and a name with an embedded unit gives each field's raw text unchanged (quotes removed per the dialect, nothing else).
- Two names that trim to the same name are reported as two raw names.
- A file with no header reports no raw names.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: - Raw names are header text, so they are covered by the same opt-in rule as other values if the descriptor policy requires it; check with the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
